import Order.Lattice
import Data.Finset
import Tactic.Basic

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [LinearOrder α] [DenselyOrdered α] (s t : Finset α) [NoMaxOrder α] [NoMinOrder α] [Nonempty α] (H : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ t, x < y) : ∃ b, (∀ x ∈ s, x < b) ∧ ∀ y ∈ t, b < y := by
  let s_nonempty := Nonempty.of_nonempty s
  let t_nonempty := Nonempty.of_nonempty t

  have h_s_nonempty : Nonempty s := s_nonempty
  have h_t_nonempty : Nonempty t := t_nonempty

  let s_max := supremum s
  let t_min := infimum t

  have h_s_max_exists : ∃ x ∈ s, x = s_max := Infimum.exists
  have h_t_min_exists : ∃ y ∈ t, y = t_min := Supremum.exists

  let s_max_val := classical.some h_s_max_exists
  let t_min_val := classical.some h_t_min_exists

  have h_s_max_in_s : s_max_val ∈ s := classical.some_spec h_s_max_exists
  have h_t_min_in_t : t_min_val ∈ t := classical.some_spec h_t_min_exists

  have h_s_max_less_t_min : s_max_val < t_min_val :=
    by exact (H s_max_val h_s_max_in_s) t_min_val h_t_min_in_t

  let b := classical.some (density_between s_max_val t_min_val)

  have h_b_between : s_max_val < b ∧ b < t_min_val :=
    by exact density_between.mp (classical.some_spec (density_between s_max_val t_min_val))

  refine ⟨b, fun x => h_b_between.1, fun y => h_b_between.2⟩
